all_drop = sum(r['drop'] for r in rows)

        type_total[s['segment_type']] += 1
        if s['label'] == 'keep':

            type_tokens_keep[s['segment_type']].append(s['token_estimate'])

    print(f'  {t:<20} total={tot:>4}, keep={k:>3}, drop={tot-k:>4}, keep_rate={k/tot*100:>5.1f}%, avg_keep_tokens={avg_t:.0f}')
